_comment: Copy this file to watchdog_config.json and fill in your values. Sensitive fields (API keys, passwords) can also be set via environment variables — env vars take precedence over file values.

_env_vars._comment: These env vars override the corresponding config fields. Set them in your .env file or server environment instead of hardcoding secrets here.
_env_vars.DASHBOARD_SECRET: dashboard_secret  ← Flask session signing key, set a strong random value

registry_database._comment: Central platform DB — stores per-foundry configs in watchdog_si_config table.
registry_database.name: sandman_dev

database._comment: Target foundry DB for single-foundry mode. Not used in multi-foundry mode.
database.name: YOUR_FOUNDRY_DB

webhook._comment: Base webhook settings. Per-foundry overrides stored in watchdog_si_config DB.
